result: holonet = holonomic quantum computer; gauge-connection holonomy 2T = SL(2,3) = single-qutrit Clifford
physical_point: gates as non-abelian holonomies (Wilczek-Zee) of the substrate gauge connection are geometric -> robust to control error (gate-level fault tolerance); the same connection's curvature gives the gauge fields
complementarity: gate level (holonomic 2T/Sp(4,3)) + analog level (GKP D4) + logical level (Steinberg/color code)
sources: Zanardi-Rasetti, Holonomic quantum computation, Phys Lett A 264, 94 (1999)
Wilczek-Zee, Appearance of gauge structure in simple dynamical systems, PRL 52, 2111 (1984)
